title: Palindrome Linked List
summary: Decide whether the values of a singly linked list read the same forwards and backwards, using O(1) extra space.

tests.explain: Read backwards the values are 1, 2, 2, 1 again.
With an odd length the middle value (3) pairs with itself and doesn't need a partner.

hints: Copying the values into an array and comparing both ends is O(n) space. For O(1), you need to walk the second half backwards without an array.
Find the middle with slow and fast pointers, then reverse the second half in place so it can be walked from the tail towards the middle.
Compare the first half with the reversed second half node by node. If you want to be tidy, reverse the second half again to restore the list.

complexity.time: O(n): find the middle, reverse half, compare half
